coverage_notes:
SOURCES USED. (1) Primary: the official "2012 Alabama Football Media Guide," scanned at archive.org (https://archive.org/details/alabama-football-2012-media-guide). This is a preseason guide (published Aug. 2012) and its COACHES AND STAFF section is the only place a full Alabama support staff for this season is enumerated: printed p. 2 = "2012 ALABAMA COACHING STAFF" directory; printed pp. 78-91 = bios of the 10 on-field coaches plus Cochran, Gonnella, Pannunzio, Allen, Springer, Sherrer, Martin; printed p. 92 = a 35-person "COACHING STAFF" support-staff photo grid. That yields 53 of the 55 rows below. (2) Corroboration near the title date: the Wayback capture of rolltide.com's official football roster page from Dec. 30, 2012 (8 days before the Jan. 7, 2013 BCS Championship Game) lists 13 coaches/senior staff, matching the guide exactly. (3) Wikipedia's 2012 team page, plus the subjects' own later official bios, for two people absent from the preseason guide.

QUOTE MECHANICS - PLEASE READ BEFORE STRING-MATCHING. Media-guide quotes are copied verbatim from the PDF's embedded text layer (extracted with PyMuPDF), not retyped. Two consequences: (a) The guide's staff pages are photo-caption grids and two-column directories, so most quotes span the source's own line breaks; these are preserved as real newlines inside the quote. (b) The PDF's font has broken ligatures, so the text layer genuinely reads "Off ensive", "Th ompson", "Th e Citadel", and "Jeff  Stoutland" / "Jeff  Allen" / "Jeff  Purinton" with two spaces. I have NOT normalized these - matching them requires the same text layer. Every media-guide quote below was programmatically confirmed present in the extracted page text before being written here.

GRID PAIRING VERIFICATION. Name-to-title pairing for all 35 support-staff grid entries was verified two independent ways: (i) text-block x/y coordinates (7 columns at x = 46.6, 121.1, 195.7, 270.3, 345.1, 419.5, 499.0; 5 rows), and (ii) rendering the page to an image and reading the captions visually. Both agree. Note the naive extraction order is NOT reliable here - it would mis-pair Jordan and Finney - so do not re-derive pairings from raw text order. For 10 of the 35 (Brown, C. Burns, Edwards, Finney, Jordan, T. Jones, Kimble, Lyerly, Moorehead, Perschel) the extractor emits the title caption in a trailing block rather than adjacent to the name; those rows carry two source entries, one quoting the name caption and one quoting the title caption, with the grid cell identified in the note. Kindal Moorehead's title string "Strength & Conditioning" is not unique on the page (Mark Hocke shares it), so his name caption is the anchoring quote.

WHAT I COULD NOT DOCUMENT - honest gaps. (a) No archived rolltide.com staff directory covering football support staff exists near the title date; the Wayback CDX/search endpoints were unreachable from this environment, and archive.org's availability API returned no snapshot for the school-bio staff-directory URL. (b) No BCS National Championship game notes were archived on rolltide.com's 2012 game-notes index (captures stop at the Nov. 26, 2012 SEC Championship release), and the late-season game-release PDFs contain no staff listing. (c) Consequently, only the 13 coaches/senior staff are independently confirmed still on staff eight days before the title game. The 35 support-staff members and Allen/Springer/Sherrer/Martin are documented for the 2012 season by the preseason guide but their individual continuity through Jan. 7, 2013 is NOT separately verified. (d) I found no documentation of any mid-season arrival or departure, so no midseason_note is set on any row. Departures I could date all fall after the title game: Kevin Sherrer left for South Alabama in Feb. 2013 (per the 2013 Spring Media Guide: "Stevenson takes over for Kevin Sherrer, who was named the defensive coordinator at South Alabama."), and Stoutland, Rumph, Groh and Pruitt were all still listed on Dec. 30, 2012. (e) The 2013 Spring Media Guide is a short guide with no support-staff grid, so it could not be used to confirm the 35 support staff.

JUDGMENT CALLS you may want to override. (1) George Helow and John Van Dam are the only two rows not in the preseason media guide; both are corroborated by their own official later bios, and Helow's Michigan bio carries a year-by-year table row reading "2012 Alabama Defensive Intern". Wikipedia's analyst/GA section (its only footnote is an unrelated Tim Castille article) is weak on its own, which is why I sourced both independently. (2) Jeff Purinton is an athletics-department title, but it is football-dedicated and printed in the guide's "2012 ALABAMA FOOTBALL DIRECTORY"; drop this row if the dataset counts program-employed staff only. I deliberately excluded department-wide administrators printed in that same directory (Mal Moore, Shane Lyons, Thad Turnipseed, etc.) and the athletics communications writers credited on p. 3. (3) Several grid members hold department-wide rather than football-only roles (Cedric Burns, Gary Cramer, Brandy Moore, the two state troopers, and the three video staff) but are printed inside the football guide's COACHING STAFF section, so I kept them. (4) Roles are given exactly as the source words them, including the guide's own typos - Jody Wright is printed "Offensive Analysts" and John Wozniak "Special Teams Analysts", both plural in the original. (5) Chris Samuels is "Student Assistant" in the guide though Wikipedia lists him among offensive analysts; I used the guide's wording and category "other". (6) No one on this staff carried a "quality control" title - Alabama used "analyst" - so no qc rows.
